_comment: Core base merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by bin/link-harness (union), together with packs/*/permissions.json. Manual install: permissions + hooks, __ROOT__ = this repo. Plugin mode: only permissions (hooks/hooks.json registers the guards). Platform deny/ask rules live in the packs; here only the core ones: deny = editing the security profile and the read-only mode file, the harness configuration folder, the user's Claude Code settings.json and settings.local.json and the installed copy of the plugin (only the user changes them; ro-guard covers Bash, hooks/lib/protected.sh; a harness that is a git clone is where it is developed and is not protected), ask = git force push and hard reset (confirm and show the exact command). bin/link-harness adds to deny one Read(…) rule per credential file (hooks/credential-guard/credential-files, packs/*/credential-files). sandbox = the core part of the sandbox of the strict profile only (bin/lib/packs.sh packs_sandbox): commands that run outside it (ro, the read-only gate, reads the cloud credentials itself) and the domains every pack needs (GitHub); the packs add their domains and every credential file is denied inside it.
